freeze_rule: Protocol and both question banks are fixed before reading new GPU outcomes. Calibration and evaluation problems are disjoint.
calibration: 8 independent native trajectories, one seed, complete EOS or actual capacity. Used for descriptive difficulty, cost and coverage. No formal-bank substitution by outcome.
formal_bank: 16 fixed new problems x 2 fixed seeds. Two metadata strata families: AIME contest questions and text-only single-numeric OlympiadBench algebra or number theory.
main_budget: Native thinking temperature 0.6, top_p 0.95, top_k 20, no scientific generation-length or wall cap. Actual model context limit is recorded separately.
prerequisite: D2.5 offline and frozen scoring tests, 4/4 D2 no-cue identity with an actual side audit and a real-device controlled scope/action test.
observe_then_select: Verify the whole native bank. Select a maximum of four distinct problems, based solely on a live completed step, typed mathematics, source, and replayable scope. Freeze selection and roles before any paired output or evaluation-answer read.
priority: A false typed proof or natural reflection with exact checker evidence, independent source-role permission and a supported action plan
A real scoped identity or equation transition that can receive a scoped witness in the isolated auditor
tie_order: case_id, seed, step, event source span, event_id
no_eligible_target: Record the empty natural comparison with the entire formal bank denominator. A controlled injection is excluded from natural quality.

arms.NativeContinue: Original full native continuation under the matched source seed and schedule.
arms.InContextCheck: Ordinary explicit check using the complete already observed prefix, then natural EOS. Intentional main-context change.
arms.UnscopedIndependent: Fresh audit context omits scope packet. Native shadow uses original exact prompt, KV, logits and RNG; audit RNG independent.
arms.ScopedIndependent: Same audit target, deterministic scope/premise packet added. Audit seed matched across arms. Independent context and checker results logged.
arms.GenericRewindAndRebase: Only if an actual certified natural error and source-compatible repair plan exist. Match same evidence across rewind, no-carry and carry.
arms.Resampling: On licensed repairs only, record independent complete trajectories with actual forward work and wall cost; report a below/above budget bracket when exact matching is unavailable. No choice by Gold.

audit_guard: 80 generated auditor tokens; applies to the independent auditor only. Auditor content can propose a witness, not certify it.
scoring: Immutable pre-Gold arm/result manifests. Extract complete mathematical object without a reference, then score all arms under the same pinned semantic checker. D2 historical LastBox scores are separate.
statistics: Event, extracted object, scope, checker execution, checker verdict, role/action and actual branch execution have different denominators. Final correct and paired repairs/harms cluster by problem; selected diagnostic trajectories are not full-bank effects. Bill native, audit, clone, replay, discard, resolution and EOS, and report actual peak allocation.
